topNews.text: The Real Way to Save Bees During a Drought: Expert Corrects Sugar–Water Myth
topNews.excerpt: A British bee scientist recently explained that setting up ‘hydration stations’ for bees doesn’t work, as the commonly-proffered mixture of sugar in water doesn’t revive tired bees at all. topNews.text: Voice Changes Measured by Phone Can Predict Asthma Flare-Ups 3 Days in Advance
topNews.excerpt: Voice changes measured with a mobile phone can detect an oncoming potentially-deadly asthma attack up to three days in advance, according to new research. Scientists from Maastricht University in the Netherlands say their high tech app can also provide a vital early warning for symptoms of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).
